title: yokoso theme
description: A theme's keys, in a theme file or in the config on top of the theme's. A look of one's own may read keys of its own too.

extends.description: The theme this one goes on top of: "dark", "light", "high-contrast", a theme's name or a theme file's path.

background.description: Behind everything, where there's no image.

text.description: The clock, the name, the lists, what's typed.

subtext.description: The date, the session, hints, the power buttons, the status in the corner.

dim.description: The field's placeholder and the arrows by the names.

accent.description: The avatar, what's under the pointer or Tab's ring, an armed power button, the field's outline and its button once something is typed.

error.description: Errors, the Caps Lock warning and a low battery.

outline.description: A solid outline around the field, the session, the power buttons and the lists; "" for a faint one around the field and the lists.

font.description: A font family; "" for the default one.

background.description: An image for every screen, or one per output with "*" for the rest; paths are relative to the theme.

backgroundDim.description: How much colors.background covers the image.

animations.description: "auto" for things that move unless everything is drawn in software, true, or false for none.

clock.description: The clock above the form, at the top, or none.

power.description: The power buttons at the bottom, in its right corner, or none.

clockFormat.description: The time as a Qt format ("HH:mm"); "" for the locale's.

dateFormat.description: The date as a Qt format ("dddd d MMMM"); "" for the locale's.

radius.description: The corners of the field, the buttons, the lists and the avatar, in pixels; null for round.

look.description: A QML file that draws the login screen instead, relative to the theme.

color.description: A color as Qt reads it: "#rrggbb", "#aarrggbb" or a name.
